prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop landing-page composition comp for TomorrowWorks
Render a complete 1440×900 public Malaysian career guidance website viewport, edge to edge, with crisp readable text and the opening of the next section. The visitor wants one direct action that turns a present role into a possible next direction.
Use this real content: brand “TomorrowWorks”; navigation “Explore careers”, “Job market”, “How it works”, “For organisations”; utility “BM / 中文”; headline “Your experience can take you further.”; short copy “Start with the work you know.”; working sentence “I work as [Accounting assistant]”; action “Show me where it can lead”; proof “Malaysian job-market evidence · No CV required”; next section heading “One role. More than one possible future.”
Composition: Threshold Line. The headline occupies a very open upper field. Across the lower third, one continuous deep-ink horizontal band acts as an architectural threshold and contains the complete sentence-form input and green action. A single thin route rule exits the action into the lighter next section below. The band is calm, shallow and highly legible, creating one decisive transition without becoming a dashboard or banner stack.
One Clear Step visual law: near-white field, deep blue-black ink band, restrained forest green action, warm grey hairlines; refined contemporary sans typography, precise margins and premium restraint.
Do not add destination cards, career results, statistics, badges, photography, illustrations, feature rows, gradients, floating panels, decorative icons or AI imagery. No browser frame or watermark.
